description: This file contains unit tests for the citywide risk API endpoints, specifically testing the GET /api/v1/citywide-risk route, including data retrieval, filtering, validation, pagination, caching, statistics calculation, and handling empty results.

methods.name: test_get_citywide_risk_pagination( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, sample_citywide_risk_data, mock_cache )
methods.description: Checks that pagination parameters limit and offset are correctly handled.

methods.description: Verifies that the cache is utilized for repeated requests to optimize performance.

methods.name: test_get_citywide_risk_calculates_summary_statistics( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, sample_citywide_risk_data, mock_cache )
methods.description: Checks that summary statistics like highest risk year and score are correctly computed.

methods.name: test_get_citywide_risk_handles_empty_result( self, mock_get_client, mock_get_cache, client, mock_cache )
methods.description: Ensures the endpoint behaves correctly when no data is returned.
